{{Short description|German political economist}}
'''Karl Friedrich Wilhelm Dieterici''' (23 August 1790 &ndash; 30 July 1859) was a German [[political economist]].

==Biography==
Dieterici was born and died in [[Berlin]]. He was an [[engineer]]-[[geographer]] in [[Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher|Blücher]]'s army from 1813 to 1815, was engaged in the Ministry of Public Instruction, became professor of political science in the [[Humboldt University of Berlin|University of Berlin]], and in 1844 was placed at the head of the statistical bureau. He published a number of important works on political economy and [[statistics]], among which may be mentioned: ''De Via et Ratione Œconomiam Politicam Docendi'' and ''Statistische Uebersicht der wichtigsten Gegenstände des Verkehrs und Verbrauchs im preussischen Staat und im deutschen Zollverband'' (1838).
